title: It’s a corded vac
text: It’s a corded vac. I returned it.  Thought it was cordless  as description merely said handheld.  And image never showed a cord.  when I got it it was a corded stick vac and thus not what I thought I was ordering. It’s a corded vac.

product_metadata.title: Shark Rocket Ultra-Light Upright Vacuum Cleaner HV306Q Handheld Vacuum and Wide Upholstery Tool Under-Appliance Wand Pet Multi Tool for Carpet and Hard Floor (Renewed) (Pink)
features: The Shark Rocket Ultra-Light Upright Vacuum Cleaner picks up large debris and fine dust from bare floors.
This Shark Vacuum Cleaner converts into a hand vacuum for versatile floor-to-ceiling cleaning

It has an ergonomic and comfortable handle with a rubberized grip which prevents slipping and provides more control when the vacuum is used even with a single hand. Fingertip controls to easily switch from hard floor to carpet.
Vacuum Cleaner equipped with swivel steering that allows for excellent control when maneuvering around furniture.
The Shark Ultra-Light Vacuum Cleaner picks up surface litter and stuck-on debris, providing superior bare floor cleaning.
description: Shark handheld vacuums deliver quick cleaning at a moment’s notice for any mess that arises. Lightweight, powerful, and ultra-maneuverable: take on everyday cleaning in minutes with Shark cordless vacuums.  Easily convert to a hand vacuum for above-floor cleaning.  Perfect surface cleaning types like carpets, bare floors.  They can be easily used by elderly people and even kids.
